name: 空港停泊塔

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. One compact cyberpunk airship mooring tower: eight-unit tall sturdy graphite metal lattice mast on narrow integrated feet, small cream control cabin midway, broad short docking yoke near top, cyan guidance strip housings and amber cabin windows. No aircraft, detached gantry, large base plate or landscape. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 支撑脚、桁架、控制舱与停泊横梁完整，侧面较薄符合桁架结构。
